summary: Iter148 — Hair Colour shade→service link + colour bookings + CRM colour history + Before/After + Mira colour-reel. Backend pytest: 16/16 pass (test_iter148_shade_service_links.py). PUT /api/hair-colors/{color}/service correctly upserts a shade→service link with service_name+price, deletes on null, 404 on unknown colour or unknown service. GET /api/public/color/{slug} carries service_name+price on linked burgundy. POST /api/public/book/{slug} with color_code auto-adds the linked service to service_names+total for linked burgundy, and appends 'Copper Brown Colour' to service_names for unlinked copper-brown (the 'Bridal Makeup' bug reported by the user is fixed). GET /api/customers/{id}/color-history returns both appointments with color_pick.color_name Burgundy & Copper Brown. POST /api/appointments/{id}/color-result: which=after&consent=true → 200; which=side → 400; .txt → 400. POST /api/appointments/{id}/color-reel: happy path 200 with caption + results.instagram.ok=false 'not connected' (Instagram not connected — expected); GET /api/social/history includes kind='color_reel'; 400 without color_pick; 400 without consent. Frontend UI: (a) /settings → ColorTryOnCard: tap color-tile-burgundy → color-link-row + color-link-select show; select 'Hair Color - Global' → 'Service linked' toast + tile shows ₹2500 badge; set back to '— not linked' → 'Link removed' toast. (b) /appointments Upcoming: both QA Link Guest colour bookings appear with 🎨 badge; ColorPickCard renders with data-testid color-card-<appt>, color-card-reel-row, color-card-before-upload, color-card-after-upload, color-card-consent, color-card-post-reel; post-reel button correctly disabled until after photo + consent. (c) Public /color/miracurl-marathahalli (430px) after Skip: color-card-burgundy shows color-price-burgundy 'Hair Color - Global · ₹2500'. (d) /book/miracurl-marathahalli?color=burgundy&code=X: book-color-banner renders with shade + code; book-color-continue advances to services step where 'Hair Color - Global' is visible in the pre-selected Women · Hair category section. Only issue: QA Link Guest (a colour-booking-only customer with no invoice) does NOT appear in /api/customers → CRM listing, so opening the CRM history modal for this new customer via the UI is not possible from /customers page. Backend /api/customers/{id}/color-history for the same customer works (pytest test_customer_color_history passed with 2 appointments).

ui_bugs.issue: Colour-booking-only customers (created via /api/public/book with color_code but never invoiced) do NOT appear in the /api/customers listing that CRM.jsx uses. As a result, the CustomerHistoryModal (and its customer-colour-history block) cannot be opened from /customers for these guests, even though GET /api/customers/{id}/color-history returns 2 valid appointments for them. Search by name 'QA Link Guest' or phone '9000000088' returns 'No customers yet.' Likely the /api/customers query filters on has-invoice / visits>0 / recent activity, but colour bookings should also count.
ui_bugs.selector: /customers search input + row for 'QA Link Guest'

action_items: Include customers with colour bookings (appointments having color_pick, even if no invoice/visits) in the /api/customers CRM listing so the CustomerHistoryModal → customer-colour-history flow is reachable from the UI. Alternatively, add a quick 'Open history' link on Appointments row so staff can open the modal directly for colour guests.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/hair_colors.py post_color_reel: `_load(cp['image_url'])` treats the try-on preview URL as an internal upload id — but the picker's `image_url` on many shades is an absolute /api/files/<id> (works) OR the catalogue's server-side hair_color_images entry, which does NOT live in the uploads collection. If a shade only has a catalog image (no 'before' upload) the reel silently falls through with `before=None`; the AFTER-only card renders but the 'AI catalogue preview as before' feature won't work. Guard with a try/except and skip on lookup miss.

backend/routes/hair_colors.py post_color_reel: does not check `body.platforms` — an empty list would still generate the card + caption but publish nothing; consider defaulting to ['instagram','facebook'] via Pydantic default (already there) but also raise 400 if the platforms list is empty after validation.

backend/routes/public_site.py _create_public_appointment (color_code branch): if the color_code exists but the slug does not match its tenant, the lookup silently misses because it uses tenant_id + code — good; however, the code accepts any body.color_code without upper-casing before .strip(), so a lower-case UUID-suffixed code from an older flow would 404. Already handled (`body.color_code.strip().upper()`) — ok.

frontend/src/components/settings/ColorTryOnCard.jsx: setLinking(c) uses the whole color object; when the same shade is tapped twice the row toggles between an open and closed state only via the close button — not by re-tapping the tile. Minor UX polish: re-tapping the same tile could close the row.

frontend/src/components/appointments/ColorPickCard.jsx: `upload` sends `consent=<state>` as a query parameter — but the checkbox default is `!!cp?.consent`, so before consent is checked the very first Before/After upload persists `color_pick.consent=false`. If the stylist then ticks consent and clicks 'Mira: post before/after', the reel POST body carries `consent:true` and 200s — good. But the two-step consent (upload without consent, post with consent) is slightly confusing; consider disabling the upload button until consent is checked, matching the spec 'consent checkbox and post-reel button disabled until After photo + consent'.

frontend/src/pages/CRM.jsx (implicit): /api/customers appears to hide customers with only colour bookings (no invoice) — see UI bug. Root cause probably in backend customers list endpoint filtering by visits/spend.

rca_of_the_issue: CRM listing hides colour-booking-only customers: /api/customers is the source for the CRM.jsx table and its search. When a customer is created via the public colour-booking flow (POST /api/public/book with color_code, no invoice yet), the customer row DOES exist in db.customers (verified via motor find_one on tenant_id+name), but the CRM listing endpoint returns 0 hits for name 'QA Link Guest' and phone '9000000088'. Likely the endpoint filters on has-invoice or visits > 0 (typical CRM 'past guests' filter). Fix: either (a) union customers-with-color-picks / customers-with-any-appointment into the CRM feed, or (b) expose an explicit 'Open history' shortcut on the /appointments colour row that mounts CustomerHistoryModal for that customer_id — the modal + colour-history block already render correctly when given a valid customer object (GET /api/customers/{id}/color-history works and returns 2 appointments per pytest).
